visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Sandy stands alone in a studio environment against a black wall covered in 'JKF' logos. She wears a white T-shirt under a black leather pinafore dress and black boots, holding a small microphone. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and smiles. (2) A second female guest (Yin Yin) enters the frame, wearing an off-the-shoulder white knit sweater with faux fur trim and black shorts. They stand together in front of a red leather sofa. (3) A third guest (Aki) enters, wearing a white tiered midi dress and white sandals. The background remains the same. (4) The scene shifts to a game segment where Yin Yin acts out anime characters through physical movements (squatting like Luffy, mimicry of Kamehameha). Sandy and Aki are seen reacting in a small PiP overlay or off-camera. (5) Aki takes her turn acting out characters, using hand signs for Naruto and mimicking volleyball spikes for Haikyuu. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout. (6) The video transitions to a dance segment where Aki performs a rhythmic dance to electronic music, and Sandy joins in beside her, laughing. (7) All three women stand together holding a promotional poster for 'JKF 2025 Sexiest Lady'. They wave and smile towards the camera as on-screen text overlays provide voting dates.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female greeting opens the audio track with bright, compressed vocal quality. An upbeat, medium-tempo pop instrumental plays in the background. (2) Vocal interplay between three females follows, characterized by frequent laughter and high arousal. (3) A sharp digital 'Ding' sound effect triggers a transition into the game round. (4) During the acting segment, short percussive thuds and fabric rustling from physical movement are audible under the continuous BGM. (5) Strategic cartoon-style 'whoosh' and success chimes are layered over the speech as characters are guessed. (6) A sudden shift to high-BPM electronic dance music (Phonk style) occurs for the penalty dance; vocals become sparse, mostly featuring rhythmic exclamations. (7) The final phase returns to structured narration with a lower-volume BGM bed as the hosts deliver a promotional call-to-action.
